## Description

Brief description of changes.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

### Code quality
- [ ] Types pass (`make typecheck`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`make lint`)
- [ ] No cyclomatic complexity > 10
- [ ] No files > 300 lines
- [ ] Docstrings on public functions

### Testing
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Coverage gate holds (`make test`)
- [ ] Traceability: new P0 ACs have matching tests

### Accessibility
- [ ] axe clean on affected screens
- [ ] Keyboard path verified
- [ ] Screen-reader announcements checked
- [ ] No color-only indicators

### Security
- [ ] No document content in logs
- [ ] No secrets in code
- [ ] PII masking covers new patterns (if applicable)

### Documentation
- [ ] README updated (if applicable)
- [ ] ADR added (if applicable)
- [ ] Prompt version bumped (if prompt changed)
- [ ] Fixtures re-recorded (if prompt changed)
